# Milestone v1.0 Audit: Shed Basics

**Audited:** 2026-03-19
**Status:** tech_debt

The milestone meets its intent: the live stock of every shed is on one screen and a tool in transit stays findable until the receiving steward confirms it. One requirement is only partly met and three small items are carried forward as tech debt, none of them blocking.

## Verdict

Ship it. The kiosk preference gap is recorded under gaps and the carried items are listed by phase above.
